:::{#exr-rss-ols-fit}
#### Residual sum of squares of the OLS fit

Assuming $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
write the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss)
of the OLS fit (@thm-ols-slr),
$\sumin \resid_i^2$,
in terms of $S_{xx}$, $S_{yy}$ and $S_{xy}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-ols-fit}

The [fitted values](estimation.qmd#def-fitted-value)
of the OLS fit are $\fitted_i = \hintcoef + \hcoef{x} x_i$,
so each [residual](estimation.qmd#def-residual) is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\resid_i = y_i - \fitted_i
&= y_i - (\bar{y} - \hcoef{x} \bar{x}) - \hcoef{x} x_i
&& \text{(substitute $\hintcoef$)}\\
&= (y_i - \bar{y}) - \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})
&& \text{(regroup)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Squaring and summing:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin \resid_i^2
&= \sumin \paren{(y_i - \bar{y})^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})(y_i - \bar{y})
  + \hcoef{x}^2 (x_i - \bar{x})^2}
&& \text{(expand the square)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \hcoef{x} S_{xy} + \hcoef{x}^2 S_{xx}
&& \text{(definitions of $S_{yy}$, $S_{xy}$, $S_{xx}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}} + \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}}
&& \text{(substitute $\hcoef{x} = S_{xy} / S_{xx}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
